SELECT STRING_AGG(details.names, ',') as handle_person, fault.name as fault_class_name, remind.* FROM tpm_repair_remind as remind INNER JOIN (SELECT name, id FROM tpm_repair_fault_class WHERE del_flag = '0') as fault ON remind.fault_class_id = fault.id INNER JOIN (SELECT names, remind_code FROM tpm_repair_remind_details WHERE person_type = '0' ) as details ON remind.remind_code = details.remind_code WHERE remind.del_flag= '0'
AND remind.remind_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.remindCode},'%')
AND fault.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.faultClassName},'%')
AND remind.device_codes LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.deviceCodes},'%')
AND remind.device_names LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.deviceNames},'%')
AND remind.shift_names LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.shiftNames},'%')
GROUP BY remind.id, remind.remind_code, fault.name ORDER BY remind.create_time DESC

SELECT remind.* FROM tpm_repair_remind as remind
AND #{deviceCode} = ANY(string_to_array(remind.device_codes, ','))
AND #{shiftCode} = ANY(string_to_array(remind.shift_codes, ','))
AND fault_class_id = #{faultClassId}
